title: OPEN DOORS PRAYER
REVELATION 3:8
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision

scenes.a: Stand in quiet faith today before the risen Christ who holds the sovereign key of David.
Revelation three verse eight proclaims, Behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it.
James one verse five promises, If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally.
Even when your own strength feels small, Christ goes before faithful servants to unlock right thresholds.
Lord Jesus, guide interviews, vocations, and studies, and close every path that would lead away from peace.
With favour compass your people as with a shield and establish the honest work of our hands today.
Type Amen and subscribe to The Provision Table to walk in God's daily wisdom and provision.
